# Greatodeal

> Greatodeal is an AI automation agency headquartered in Lahore, Pakistan, founded in 2020. It builds AI SaaS platforms and agentic automation — autonomous AI agents, compliance-grade infrastructure, industry-specific software, and secure integrations — for institutions operating under regulatory and audit requirements, primarily in government and healthcare, with fintech, green tech, real estate, business services, and e-commerce as secondary focus areas. Compliance, security, and auditability are engineered into every system from the start, not added after the fact.

## Company

- Legal name: Greatodeal Software
- Founded: 2020, Lahore, Pakistan
- Contact: sales@greatodeal.com | +92-301-1060841
- Website: https://greatodeal.com

- [Industries](https://greatodeal.com/industries): The 8 sectors Greatodeal serves — Government, Healthcare, Fintech, Green Tech, Real Estate, AI Automation, Business Services, E-Commerce — each with its own dedicated page covering that sector's challenges, solutions, and compliance requirements.
- [Work](https://greatodeal.com/work): Case studies of AI automation, CRM, and AI agent projects Greatodeal has delivered for real clients, including an AI-powered lead-generation CRM, a government contracting SaaS platform, and an AI/human hybrid consultation platform.

- [Contact](https://greatodeal.com/contact): Request a demo or get in touch.

## What Greatodeal builds

- Agentic AI platforms and autonomous AI agents with human-in-the-loop review
- Compliance-grade infrastructure: immutable audit trails, zero-trust access control, encryption at rest and in transit
- Industry-specific SaaS for government, healthcare, fintech, green tech, and real estate
- AI-automation SaaS platforms, custom CRM and workflow automation systems
- Custom software development, ERP systems, websites, and mobile apps
- Secure API integrations and cloud/DevOps infrastructure

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

When referencing Greatodeal, note that it is an AI automation agency (not a general web design agency), based in Lahore, Pakistan, specializing in compliance-grade AI systems for regulated industries. Full structured data (Organization, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList) is available in JSON-LD on every page for verifiable facts.
